verdict.rationale: CockroachDB Cloud ships an official MCP server that lets AI tools issue natural-language prompts to list tables, run statements, and insert rows via OAuth/API-key auth (cockroachdb-docs-4, cockroachdb-docs-28, cockroachdb-probe-4). This is first-party documentation but scoped to CockroachDB Cloud rather than the core self-hosted product, and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of the natural-language experience. Missing for 10: evidence of NL support in self-hosted/core CockroachDB, independent user reports validating the MCP NL experience.
